binary.note: Read-only static disassembly via tools/capstone. No native code executed.

quantumComponent.Creator: 0x1817d11c0
quantumComponent.OnRecvEvent: absent - BlinkBlock has no event handler at all

supportingCalls.packedSevenSlotDecoder: 0x18096f720 (byte loop 0x18096f80c: low byte of each UTF-16 unit minus 0x21)
supportingCalls.visibilityFlag: ActorComponent.m_Flags bit 3 (il2cpp +28, struct +0xc). IsVisible 0x18169f010 is `test byte[rcx+0xc],8; setbe` so bit 3 SET means hidden
supportingCalls.collisionToggle: setVisible 0x18169ef39 calls ActorComponent.SetCollisionActive 0x18169ff50 with the same bool, so a hidden BlinkBlock has no collider at all
supportingCalls.deltaTime: Frame.get_DeltaTime 0x18173a090 - only forwards a runtime session field ([frame+0xc8]+0x80), so its FP raw is NOT in the binary

constants.RectFPMemberOrder: Height +16, Width +24, X +32, Y +40 (il2cpp field offsets). Cross-checked against PlayerComponent..cctor 0x1816cba29..0x1816cbd22 where COLLISION_W=32, COLLISION_H=46, COLLISION_X=-16, COLLISION_Y=-47 land in exactly that order and reproduce actor-runtime.js rects.Player
constants.collisionFlagBit: m_Flags bit 4 set at 0x1817d1918..0x1817d1925 (meaning not identified)
constants.collisionType: CreateCollision is called with type 2 (solid) at 0x1817d18e8; m_CollisionType is forced to 0/Rect at 0x18169f586
constants.pushBackTarget: 2 - so IsCollidedByPushBackTarget's bit 0 (MapComponent.IsContacted, the tile map) is masked out and only bit 1 (the active collision list) runs
constants.viewEffectFill: clamp(1 - m_Timer / m_AppearTime, 0, 1) at 0x1805bea5c..0x1805bea9d, constants 1.0f (0x182e87104) and 1/65536f (0x182e86e14)

dataSlotMap.0: BlinkBlockType: 0 = Small (30x30 collider), 1 = Large (46x46). `sar raw,0x10` then stored as m_Type byte at 0x1817d1597.
dataSlotMap.1: m_AppearTime - how long the block stays VISIBLE, in seconds. Raw FP copied at 0x1817d15a0 ONLY when non-zero; Creator 0x1817d12ef / Initialize 0x1817d13a0 preload INTERVAL_TIME, so 0 or absent means 1.0 s.
dataSlotMap.2: m_DisappearTime - how long the block stays HIDDEN, in seconds. Same non-zero rule at 0x1817d15aa, same 1.0 s default.
dataSlotMap.3: m_IsAppearAtStart - boolean, `setne` at 0x1817d15b5. Decides the starting visibility, m_IsVisibleTiming AND which duration m_Timer starts with (InitPost 0x1817d19e6).
dataSlotMap.4: m_FuncType - 0 = func_default, any non-zero = 1 = func_keep. Written at 0x1817d15c1; OnUpdate 0x1817d1a59 dispatches on it.
dataSlotMap.5: Packed per-player-count table ADDED to m_AppearTime. 56 chars = seven little-endian FP raw longs for counts 2..8; index count-2, walking DOWN to lower counts while the entry is zero (0x1817d1616..0x1817d16a7).
dataSlotMap.6: Same packed table ADDED to m_DisappearTime (0x1817d16cc..0x1817d1759).
dataSlotMap.7: m_ShowEffect gate (0x1817d175e..0x1817d17bc): <=0 off, ==1 always on, N>1 means on when playerCount >= N+1.
dataSlotMap.8..31: Never read by ParseParameter. The module records a warning instead of guessing; no installed BlinkBlock uses them.

behaviour.geometry: Collider = (anchor.x + 1, anchor.y + 1, 30, 30) for Small and (anchor.x + 1, anchor.y + 1, 46, 46) for Large, in Y-down world pixels. Cross-check: with terrain-runtime TILE 48 the Large box is exactly centred in its tile cell (st_b_01_08 anchor 96,144 -> 97..143 / 145..191, centre 120/168 = cell centre), and the st_w_04_03 Small boxes sit at cell+8 on X so their centre is the cell centre too.
behaviour.visibility: Visible == solid. setVisible flips ActorComponent.m_Flags bit 3 and calls SetCollisionActive with the same flag, so a hidden block has no collider.
behaviour.funcDefault: The live visibility flag IS the state. When m_Timer hits <= 0: visible -> hidden and m_Timer = m_DisappearTime; hidden -> try to appear, and on success m_Timer = m_AppearTime. A blocked appearance leaves m_Timer at or below zero, so it retries every tick and then gets a FULL m_AppearTime from the moment it actually appears (the rhythm shifts).
behaviour.funcKeep: m_IsVisibleTiming is a separate schedule that flips on its own cadence and immediately reloads m_Timer with the new state's duration, whether or not the block could actually appear. A blocked appearance therefore loses that slot of the cycle but the overall rhythm never drifts; if the space frees mid cycle the block appears with only the remaining time.
behaviour.appearanceBlocking: Only the ACTIVE COLLISION LIST can stop a block from appearing - players, pushboxes, other visible blocks. The tile map cannot, because m_PushBackTarget is 2 and that masks out IsCollidedByPushBackTarget's map branch. Hiding is never blocked and nobody is ever crushed.
behaviour.events: None. BlinkBlockComponent has no OnRecvEvent, so a BlinkBlock cannot be driven by a Switch, SwitchObserver, Key or CollisionSwitch.
behaviour.effect: When m_ShowEffect and m_AppearTime > 0, the view feeds clamp(1 - m_Timer / m_AppearTime, 0, 1) into a shader float - a fill that grows as the visible time runs out. Exposed as effectFill(block).

installedParameterSets.meaning: 8 Small blocks, visible 1 s / hidden 1 s, start visible, func_default, no effect
8 Large spawn platforms that hold for 5 s then leave for 1000 s
Large, func_keep, hidden 0.1 s, visible 1.0 s (1.5 s from 5 players up via slot 5), effect shown from 5 players up
Large, both durations fall back to INTERVAL_TIME 1 s, starts hidden, func_default

unresolved: Frame.DeltaTime's FP raw could not be read: Frame.get_DeltaTime 0x18173a090 forwards a runtime session field, and the value lives in a Unity asset, not in GameAssembly.dll. 1/60 is not representable in 16.16 fixed point, so the original cycle is either 60 or 61 native ticks per authored second depending on that raw. This port expires a duration on its exact seconds tick (60 ticks at 60 Hz) and uses a 1e-9 tolerance to stay drift-free. VERIFY IN GAME before claiming tick-exact fidelity.

The float->FP quantisation the stage loader applies to the authored JSON decimals was not traced, so durations are kept as the authored decimals (e.g. 0.1 s, not 6553/65536 s = 0.09999847 s). Worst case error is 1/65536 s per duration.

The meaning of ActorComponent.m_Flags bit 5 (also toggled by setVisible at 0x18169eeef/0x18169ef21) and of Collision.m_Flags bit 4 (set in InitCollision at 0x1817d1918) was not identified. Neither affects solidity or timing.

Collision ordering inside a tick is still the browser AABB approximation shared by every source-*-devices module: the appearance test uses the player positions from the start of the tick, while the original evaluates it inside the native collision scene update. completePhysicsFidelity stays false.

The 'obstacles' input is implemented but NOT wired by the suggested registration: only players are passed. Bridges, pushboxes and gates are active colliders in the original and would also block an appearance. In st_w_04_03 none of them overlap a BlinkBlock, so nothing changes there, but a later stage will need them passed in.

Which exact colliders createActiveCollisionInfoList 0x1817f6b50 enumerates (layer and priority filtering) was not decoded; the module approximates it as 'alive players + visible blink blocks + supplied actor colliders'.
BlinkBlockEffect.SetSize / SetPropotion and the sprite atlas entries were not ported - this module is simulation only, the renderer still has to draw the box and the optional fill.
BlinkThunderComponent (0x1817d2050..0x1817d2c40, used by st_w_04_04) shares the same timer design but has its own OnCollided/OnRecvEvent. It is NOT covered by this module.

st_w_04_03 itself is only fully playable for 2-6 players: at 7+ the stage adds two population-gated SwitchTimer actors (playerCount 7) which no module handles yet. That is a separate device, not a BlinkBlock gap.
